title: Time-aware crash-severity modelling: STATS19 and CAS
description: Version 1.3.1 adds the separately recorded post hoc QWK true-class-prevalence sensitivity for Appendix A.14.6 and Table A13. It includes calculation code, protocol, tests, compact reference tables, and a separate reproduction entry using completed final 15-feature STATS19 outputs. The primary model rules, data archives, V2 result catalog, and historical tags remain unchanged. The addition was specified after primary results were known and is not preregistered. Conditional bootstrap intervals fix observed class proportions and fitted models. No model refitting or new predictions are required for this postprocessing. Seven focused tests and a separate author-run postprocessing reconstruction passed; this is not a new full raw-to-model, cross-platform, or independent third-party validation. See docs/RELEASE_v1.3.1.md and docs/QWK_PREVALENCE_SENSITIVITY.md. Raw data, fitted models, and record-level arrays are excluded. The parent v1.3.0 software DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.22642853 and does not contain this addition; data snapshots remain at 10.5281/zenodo.22290566 and 10.5281/zenodo.22296725.
